questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Yolandi Potgieter or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Yolandi Potgieter: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: At which ground did Megan Fourie record their career-best bowling figures (3-7, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Iinyathi on 2022/03/12.

questions.question: Elandri Janse van Rensburg set a database record (25/26 season, List A) with a value of 380. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Runs', held by Elandri Janse van Rensburg.

questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
Ayabonga Khaka has played 95 List A matches for South African provincial sides. How many T20 matches has she played, per this database?
questions.explanation: Khaka's List A to T20 ratio (95 to 19, roughly 5 to 1) is far more lopsided than most of her national teammates, several of whom sit closer to 1.5 to 1.

questions.question: At which ground did Dragons record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — highest total of 420, against Boland on 2019/02/02.
